newsitem.title: USA: Southern Electronics sees Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: Southern Electronics sees Q1 charge.

text.p: Southern Electronics Corp said Friday that it expects to incur one-time start-up costs in its upcoming first quarter ending September 30 of up to $0.11, after tax, per share.

The charge is due to the purchase by its operating subsidiary, SED International Inc, of certain assets of Globelle Inc, said Ray Risner, president and chief operatring officer of Southern Electronics.
The charge reflects the costs associated with retaining the new sales people, sales office relocations, and other related items, he said.
Southern Electronics distributes microcomputers, computer peripheral products and cellular telephone products to value-added resellers and dealers.
